model_package.unit_system: SWMM CMS (length m; runoff flow m3/s; rainfall intensity mm/hr)

notes: Synthetic rainfall and topology only; no catchment observations or empirical calibration.

assumptions: Synthetic 1 hectare subcatchment and one conduit; no real Johannesburg catchment is represented.
Rainfall is a declared synthetic intensity time series and is not a design storm or return-period claim.
The baseline conduit diameter is 0.6 m; the declared candidate is a deliberate synthetic restriction to 0.25 m, not a design recommendation.
SWMM is the designated physical solver; this contract/fixture alone supplies no hydraulic output.

changes.rationale: Deliberately synthetic conduit restriction for reference-adapter testing; not a proposed engineering intervention.

scenario.rationale: Run a pinned SWMM baseline and a candidate created by changing only conduit C1 circular diameter. No solver run or empirical hydraulic conclusion is claimed.

notes: Input and scenario identity only. No SWMM process was executed; no hydraulic output exists.

validation.claim_ceiling: Synthetic fixture and adapter contract only; not solver-executed, calibrated, empirically validated, or engineering-approved.

nonclaims: This fixture does not establish a calibrated real-catchment model or flood warning capability.
No real municipal topology, rainfall observation, sewer incident, receiving-water condition, or public-safety effect is included.
No flood-safety, sewer-compliance, environmental, intervention-benefit, or engineering approval claim is made.
No fieldwork, control-system operation, or automated actuation is authorized.
